Our Services

At Pawsitive Care Veterinary Clinic, we provide comprehensive healthcare services for dogs, cats, and small animals. From routine checkups to specialized treatments, our experienced team is here to keep your pets healthy and happy.

What We Offer

🩺

Wellness Exams

Regular checkups to monitor your pet's overall health, detect early signs of illness, and keep vaccinations up to date.

Starting at $65

💉

Vaccinations

Essential immunizations to protect your pets from preventable diseases. We offer core and non-core vaccine options.

Starting at $35

🦷

Dental Care

Professional cleanings and oral health assessments to prevent dental disease and maintain fresh breath.

Starting at $150

🔬

Laboratory Testing

Blood work, urinalysis, and other diagnostic tests to quickly identify health issues and guide treatment plans.

Starting at $45

⚕️

Surgery

Spaying, neutering, and other surgical procedures performed with state-of-the-art equipment and pain management.

Starting at $250

🏥

Hospitalization

24-hour care for pets requiring overnight monitoring and intensive treatment in our fully equipped facility.

Starting at $100/day

Wellness Exams

What to Expect

During a wellness exam, Dr. Martinez or one of our veterinarians will:

  • Perform a thorough physical examination
  • Review your pet's medical history
  • Check vital signs and weight
  • Assess dental health
  • Discuss nutrition and lifestyle
  • Recommend preventative care

Why Regular Exams Matter

Regular wellness exams are the foundation of preventative pet care. They allow us to catch health issues early, before they become serious. We recommend annual exams for adult pets and twice-yearly exams for senior pets (age 7+).

Puppies and kittens benefit from exams every 3–4 weeks until they are fully vaccinated.

Vaccinations

Our Vaccination Schedule

For Dogs:

  • Rabies – Required by law
  • DHPP (Distemper, Hepatitis, Parvovirus, Parainfluenza)
  • Bordetella (Kennel Cough)
  • Leptospirosis
  • Lyme Disease

For Cats:

  • Rabies – Required by law
  • FVRCP (Feline Viral Rhinotracheitis, Calicivirus, Panleukopenia)
  • FeLV (Feline Leukemia)

Vaccination Process

We'll create a customized vaccination plan based on your pet's age, lifestyle, and health status. Puppies and kittens require a series of shots spaced 3–4 weeks apart, while adult pets need booster shots annually or as recommended.

After vaccination, some pets may experience mild soreness at the injection site or slight lethargy—these symptoms typically resolve within 24 hours.

Dental Care

Professional Cleaning

Just like humans, pets need professional dental cleanings to remove tartar and plaque that brushing alone cannot eliminate. Our dental cleaning procedure includes:

  • Pre-anesthetic bloodwork for safety
  • Ultrasonic scaling above and below the gumline
  • Polishing for a smooth, clean surface
  • Fluoride treatment for protection
  • Extraction of severely damaged teeth if needed

Home Dental Care Tips

Maintaining good oral health between visits is essential:

  • Brush your pet's teeth daily with pet-safe toothpaste
  • Provide dental chews and toys
  • Choose high-quality food that promotes dental health
  • Schedule annual exams and cleanings

Poor dental health can lead to serious infections affecting the heart and kidneys, so preventative care is crucial.

Spay & Neuter Surgery

The Procedure

Spaying and neutering are routine surgical procedures that prevent unwanted litters and provide significant health benefits:

  • Spaying (females): Removal of the ovaries and uterus
  • Neutering (males): Removal of the testicles

Both procedures are performed under general anesthesia with full pain management and monitoring throughout.

Health Benefits & Recovery

Benefits include:

  • Prevention of heat cycles and associated behaviors
  • Reduced risk of mammary and reproductive cancers
  • Decreased aggression and territorial behavior
  • Prevents overpopulation in shelters

Most pets recover within 7–10 days. We provide detailed post-operative care instructions and recommend limiting activity during healing.

Our Veterinarians & Team

Meet the dedicated professionals committed to providing exceptional care for your beloved pets. Our team combines years of experience with genuine compassion for animal health and wellbeing.

Veterinarians

Dr. Sarah Mitchell, DVM

Doctor of Veterinary Medicine
Specialties: Small animal medicine, preventive care, dental procedures

Dr. Mitchell brings 12 years of clinical experience and a passion for preventive healthcare. She earned her DVM from UC Davis School of Veterinary Medicine and is a certified member of the American Veterinary Medical Association.

Dr. James Chen, DVM

Doctor of Veterinary Medicine
Specialties: Surgery, orthopedics, emergency medicine

Dr. Chen is an experienced surgical specialist with 15 years in veterinary practice. He completed his DVM at Cornell University College of Veterinary Medicine and holds advanced certifications in orthopedic surgery and emergency care.

Dr. Emma Rodriguez, DVM

Doctor of Veterinary Medicine
Specialties: Exotic pets, behavioral medicine, nutrition counseling

Dr. Rodriguez specializes in the care of exotic and small mammal companions. With 8 years of experience, she earned her DVM from Colorado State University and is passionate about tailored nutrition and behavior management plans.

Support Staff

Lisa Thompson

Licensed Veterinary Technician (LVT)
Surgical assistance, patient care, laboratory work

Lisa has been with Pawsitive Care for 6 years and is certified in veterinary technology. She ensures smooth surgical procedures and provides compassionate post-operative care to all our patients.

Marcus Johnson

Veterinary Assistant
Patient handling, clinic operations, animal comfort

Marcus brings enthusiasm and gentleness to every interaction with our patients. He is currently pursuing his certification in veterinary technology while providing excellent support to our clinical team.

Jessica Park

Clinic Manager & Receptionist
Client relations, scheduling, clinic administration

Jessica is the friendly face greeting you at our front desk. With 4 years at Pawsitive Care, she ensures every visit runs smoothly and every client question is answered with care and professionalism.

Our Commitment to Excellence

Continuous Education

Our veterinarians and staff regularly attend continuing education courses to stay current with the latest advances in veterinary medicine and best practices in animal care.

Compassionate Care

We treat every animal as if it were our own. Our team approaches each patient with kindness, patience, and a genuine desire to improve their health and quality of life.

Clear Communication

We believe in explaining diagnoses and treatment options clearly. Your questions are always welcome, and we ensure you understand every aspect of your pet's care.
